attribution: Christopher R. Scotese, PALEOMAP PaleoAtlas for GPlates, v3 (2016); reconstruction via GPlates Web Service, University of Sydney.
notes: Seeds are manually selected modern reference locations, not supplied ancient placenames.
Every texture was visually compared at overview scale; no positional accuracy guarantee.
Conservative hold: pixel B > 1.15*R and G > 1.08*R. This is only a color heuristic, not proof of geological mismatch.
Submerged continental locations can be geologically valid; held points are retained for later review, not moved onto nearby land.
Do not display these names as ancient cities, countries or the boundaries of entire continents.
No manual shifts or invented paleocoordinates.
